snippet.title: CleanFall Ship-building Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CleanFall is a genre-blending survival roguelike where you build mobile death machines to fight off ravenous hordes, craft and alchemize gun turrets, and tunnel through subterranean ecosystems crawling with nameless horrors. While CleanFall was inspired by titles like Spelunky, Noita, Terraria, Dome Keeper, and Dig or Die, I think it still bears its own unique identity.

After hearing feedback from the community, I have decided to develop some more complex ship building mechanics. Hopefully this trailer can showcase how cave divers can now murder the local wildlife from the comfort of their very own jury-rigged airships.

CleanFall will be releasing in Early Access on August 8, 2025

You can purchase CleanFall here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2769780/CleanFall/

You can join the Discord here: https://discord.gg/rmbsr9nMn4
